newsitem.title: USA: U.S. STOCK INDEX FUTURES CLOSE SHARPLY HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: U.S. STOCK INDEX FUTURES CLOSE SHARPLY HIGHER.

text.p: Aug 6 - U.S. stock index futures closed sharply higher, with Sept S&Ps settling at record highs. Sept rose to 968.00, a record high, after U.S. T-bond futures ended with a firm tone. Resistance is at 970.00, traders said.
Fed's Beige Book suggested US interest rates will stay steady in the near term. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk, 312-408-8750))
